description: This Java class handles MQTT subscriptions specifically for HiveMQ MQTT v3 protocol within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity services. It extends an abstract subscription handler and provides logic to convert source addresses into MQTT subscription requests.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3SubscriptionHandler
classes.description: Final class responsible for managing MQTT v3 subscriptions for specific connections, extending an abstract handler with MQTT v3 specific logic.

methods.name: HiveMqtt3SubscriptionHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the subscription handler with connection, MQTT client, and logger.

methods.name: toMqttSubscribe
methods.description: Converts a source object into an MQTT subscription request, mapping addresses to MQTT subscription objects with QoS settings.
